mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 70 degrees.

The City of Verona has released several notices regarding the upcoming November and April elections. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7th to review development projects, including a site plan and traffic analysis for the Sub-Zero project in Liberty Business Park.

We have a full calendar for you. Live music is at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Next week is packed with trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory.
In a report covering last week, officers responded to a situation on Sunday, October 19, where a man was taken into custody for operating while suspended and an outstanding warrant.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Mint Explosion at Culver's, and you can head over there when they open today at 10:00 AM.
